ContractHistory.description: Complete history for one discriminator identity.

envelope.description:
Whether the version envelope follows the discriminator on the wire.

Accounts and events are always enveloped. An instruction is recorded
without one unless its declaration opts in with the `migrations` token:
its single snapshot then gates wire-breaking changes, and it carries no
version byte and no transitions.

rustName.description: Current Rust source name. It is not part of stable identity.

DataSchema.description:
Canonical source schema for one version.

A version stores the facts a reader cannot recompute — the layout family and
the fields in physical order. The wire format they are derived under is
implied by the document's `abiVersion` ([`SCHEMA_CODEC`]), and the
byte-level descriptor is derived on load rather than stored, so a document
cannot disagree with its own derivation and a layout change is a deliberate,
visible version event instead of a silently reinterpreted cache.

fields.description: User fields in physical declaration order. Framework envelope fields are omitted.

name.description: Wire-significant field name used by automatic transition matching.

LayoutKind.description: Physical layout family used by a contract.

oneOf.description: Compact `PinaPod` account with a variable-length tail.

MigrationAuto.description: Contract kinds recorded without a per-item token, in stable order. Accounts and events are enveloped; instructions are recorded without an envelope unless they opt in.

MigrationVersionType.description: Program-wide integer encoding for every migration version envelope.

ProcessAccount.description:
One positional account in an instruction process.

Only wire facts are recorded: the fields here decide whether old bytes and
old account lists still parse. Declarative validation rules are program
semantics, not wire format, and live in the IDL that clients generate from;
recording them here made a validation-only change look like a wire break.

defaultValue.description: Known address emitted by generated clients, when one exists.

name.description: Stable semantic slot name. Renaming a slot is currently breaking.

optional.description: Whether an absent value is representable by this process.

pda.description: Stable Pina PDA identity, when the slot is a generated PDA.

signer.description: Signature expected by the current process.

writable.description: Privilege expected by the current process.

ProcessContract.description: Stable instruction account and authorization contract.

accounts.description: Positional account slots in transaction order.

RenameMapping.description: One field rename carried by an adjacent transition.

from.description: Field name in the source schema whose bytes move to `to`.

to.description: Field name in the destination schema receiving those bytes.

SchemaVersion.description:
One immutable schema version in a contract history.

The version number is this entry's position in the history, so it is not
stored. Schema and process hashes are computed from the decoded content, so
they are not stored either; publication receipts compute their pins from the
same functions when a deployment is recorded.

process.description: Instruction account ABI for this version. Absent for accounts and events.

transition.description:
The conversion from the previous version. Present on every later version
of a migrated contract; absent on version zero, on every event version
(events are decoded per version, never converted), and on an instruction
recorded without an envelope.

Transition.description:
Description of an adjacent schema conversion.

A transition sits on version `index` and describes the step from `index - 1`.
Adjacency, the neighbouring schema and process hashes, and the account-list
proof are all derived on load rather than stored as a second copy of the
same invariant.

implementationSha256.description: Hash of generated or manual Rust once the version is published.

renames.description:
Disambiguated field renames answered through `pina migrations create`.
Renames record source intent so repeated runs stay stable and the
generated transition moves bytes instead of dropping them.

TransitionMode.description: How a checked-in adjacent transition is implemented.

oneOf.description: Pina proved and generated the complete conversion.
The developer owns the generated typed transition function body.

description: Checked-in source of truth for every migration-aware data contract.

abiVersion.description: The ABI document version that wrote this manifest.

auto.description: Kinds whose declarations are recorded without a per-item token.

contracts.description: Every recorded history, keyed by its identity's [`ContractIdentity::key`].
